title: Rory and the Glow-Moss Hollow
verses:
The stars started blinking above in the deep,
When Rory walked slow to the edge of the stream.
The valley was sinking in shadows of sleep,
As night wrapped the trees in a silvery dream.

Then Nia swooped down with a call from the air,
And Psittaco chirped from his cozy leaf bed.
They guided the friends to a hollow so fair,
Where blue moss was glowing to light up their tread.

Now Ricky stopped sprinting to rest on the moss,
While Tilly stepped softly to find a clean space.
The breeze brought a sweet smell of blossoms across,
To wrap every friend in a tranquil embrace.

Then Benny lay down with a satisfied sigh,
As Psittaco nestled right under his wing.
The moon floated up to the top of the sky,
While night crickets whispered the song that they sing.

Now Rory yawned wide in the glow of the glade,
And curled by his friends in the shadowy light.
The cool evening wind blew a gentle cascade,
And painted the valley in peaceful delight.

Together they rested till morning should rise,
Safe, cozy, and tucked in their hollow of green.
With peaceful dreams drifting right under their eyes,
Surrounding the group in the quietest scene.
